your AI setup should not be 1 tool doing everything. it should be multiple harnesses, each pushed to what it does best.

the split:

Codex for computer and browser use
Claude Code for coding and frontend design
Grok Build for research on X
Kimi Code for writing

match the harness to the task and quality jumps immediately. the work also spreads across tools instead of queuing behind 1 session, and stacking Claude Max with GPT Pro makes it genuinely hard to run out of tokens.

but the harness is only half of it. the prompt inside it decides whether Claude Code ships production code or something you have to rewrite.

this is the one I use for production-grade architecture:

https://t.co/Ev7CaKTgz8

the rest of the library is at https://t.co/AGXMvKHudZ

follow if you're running multiple harnesses and want every one of them shipping real work.
